title: Deciding what to acquire beyond stock
target: How to think about the services and extras in TCG Card Shop Simulator, which sit on one fixed list alongside ordinary goods.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Somewhere to spend what you have earned
An idea of which job you dislike most

steps.do: Treat the list as one place with goods and services mixed together.
steps.because: the game keeps one fixed list of what can be acquired (EShopItem)

steps.do: Consider the services first if the routine is what wears you down.
steps.because: the list includes automatic restocking, automatic placing and a manager (AutoRestock)

steps.do: Check whether what you want comes in levels before deciding.
steps.because: some entries have more than one grade (StorePointUpgrade1)

steps.do: Remember some entries change the player rather than the shop.
steps.because: unlimited energy is on the same list (UnlimitedEnergy)

steps.do: Do not assume an entry is about stock rather than about packs.
steps.because: foil pack options sit on the list as well (FoilBasicPack)

commonMistakes: Assuming everything on the list is a product for the shelves.
Buying a service before the shop needs one.
Forgetting that some entries come in grades.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
